scope: Corrected proper-smooth algebraic/rigid comparison and actual canonical Tate dual in the existing V13 de-Rham lemma.

source_hypotheses.required: Smooth proper rigid variety over a complete discretely valued extension of Q_l with perfect residue field; algebraic proper comparison; Milne requires l different from field characteristic.
source_hypotheses.available: A/F is an abelian surface and F/Q_l is finite. All hypotheses hold; no good-reduction hypothesis is inserted.

constructed_objects.required: The representation must be actual geometric H1 and its Tate dual, not a similarly dimensioned abstract representation.
constructed_objects.available: A and the actual Tate action over Lprime are named in both consumer passages. Their independent construction remains a predecessor.

index_domain_coverage.required: Finite coefficient comparison for every n>=1.
index_domain_coverage.available: Use the constant sheaves Z/l^n; l^n is invertible in F, not necessarily in O_F.

transition_maps.required: Algebraic/analytic identifications must preserve cohomology, filtration, coefficient transitions and Galois action.
transition_maps.available: Naturality of the proper comparisons gives these compatibilities; coherent sheaves and de Rham differential induce a finite filtered-complex comparison.

limiting_object_identity.required: The limit must be the actual l-adic representation consumed.
limiting_object_identity.available: Take the compatible finite coefficient inverse system, use finite-group Mittag–Leffler, then invert l. No unrelated limiting class is substituted.

coefficient_conventions.required: Identify covariant Tate module and coefficient-field extension correctly.
coefficient_conventions.available: V_l(A)=H1_et(A,Q_l)^dual, no Tate twist; cyclotomic weight -1. Subsequent coefficientwise multiplicity and descent are separate BC inputs.

local_conditions.required: The local field and actual restricted representation must match.
local_conditions.available: Set F=Lprime_v over K=Q_l. Actual doubled r_l restriction is an explicit input; finite descent is not silently replaced with semistable descent.

exceptional_cases.required: Use corrected source and account for apparent residue-characteristic exception.
exceptional_cases.available: 2016 corrected definitions retained; no deleted topos-point assertion used. Field characteristic0 permits m=l^n. No claim of integral/relative comparison.

downstream_consumption.required: Deliver the exact de Rham H1/Tate predecessor to the explicit lemma and its consumers.
downstream_consumption.available: V13 passages are byte-identical to V11. BC closure/descent and later Berger/Pan, PEL realization, height49/8, RC and all-row assembly are not discharged by this source check.

non_author_scope: Reviewer did not author the manuscript comparison or historical A009 review. This is not independent acceptance of this new report itself.
open_items: Milne2008 direct PDF fresh byte verification unavailable (HTTP406); official indexed source and corrected2022 chapter read.
Publisher-typeset1986 source not freshly inspected; corrected author reconstruction explicitly labeled.
Actual abelian-surface/Tate-decomposition producer, BC descent, Berger/Pan applications, PEL/metric and height49/8 joins, restricted converse and final witnesses remain separately scoped.
